e.title: insurance-spatial-conformal
e.summary: 空间 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：地理校准的空间加权 conformal 区间
e.summary_en: Spatial conformal (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): spatially weighted conformal intervals, geographically calibrated
e.summary_hk: 空間 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：地理校準的空間加權 conformal 區間
e.body:
insurance-spatial-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空间加权的 conformal 预测区间：地理校准——相邻地区的校准权重（[[insurance-spatial]] 的区间版本）。对 RIAA：空间数据的校准——地区样本量小导致区间不稳定，空间加权借用邻近地区信息（[[insurance-conformal]] + [[insurance-spatial]] 的交叉）；与 [[insurance-multilevel]]（随机效应）配套；适合地域建模的预测区间。

## 同类工具
[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[lemur]]、[[lifeflow]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
insurance-spatial-conformal (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does spatially weighted conformal prediction intervals: geographically calibrated — calibration weights from neighbouring regions (the interval version of [[insurance-spatial]]). For RIAA: calibration under spatial data — small regional samples destabilise intervals, spatial weighting borrows neighbouring information (the intersection of [[insurance-conformal]] and [[insurance-spatial]]); pairs with [[insurance-multilevel]] (random effects); suits prediction intervals in territory modelling.

## Similar tools
[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[lemur]]、[[lifeflow]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_hk:
insurance-spatial-conformal（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做空間加權的 conformal 預測區間：地理校準——相鄰地區的校準權重（[[insurance-spatial]] 的區間版本）。對 RIAA：空間數據的校準——地區樣本量小導致區間不穩定，空間加權借用鄰近地區信息（[[insurance-conformal]] + [[insurance-spatial]] 的交叉）；與 [[insurance-multilevel]]（隨機效應）配套；適合地域建模的預測區間。

## 同類工具
[[lakeside-mutual]]、[[lemur]]、[[lifeflow]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
